changes: v2: rates are their own kind (never banded); zero is exact for every viewer including banded counts; blocked is a cell kind; money format follows the document currency
source: spec v3 'Export content and suppression' 2 to 4, applied to the mart bundle's contrib arrays; formulas verified against bundle values (heavy-refunds and disputes, months 2 and 6)

rule.zeroIsExact: a cell whose value is 0 is shown exactly (as 0, $0.00 or 0.0%) for every viewer whose policy for that kind is exact, rule or band; locked stays locked
rule.missingContrib: a contrib entry of null with a non-zero value is not_computed

policies.self: each unit is a distinct holder: passes when value is 0 or value >= 5
policies.derived: suppressed when any input is suppressed; locked when any input is locked for this viewer; not_computed when the denominator is 0; else the bundle's own value
policies.blocked: always the blocked kind with its reason, for every viewer
policies.demo-only: shown with its label only for viewer demo; every other viewer gets it in notComputed and renders not_computed

kinds.rate: a fraction; rateOf says whether any input is an amount

credits_consumed.note: the provider rule of spec v3 2(b) is not applicable: the mart has no provider contrib

breakage_rate.note: atm returns 0 when credits_granted is 0; the adapter returns not_computed

complementary.rule: in a period where the total is shown and exactly one term is suppressed, suppress the next smallest shown term

owner.decision: spec D1 (owner is the controller); the spec's principal table says 'exact when the cell rules pass': owner question, recorded in R/S1/reference-diff.md

locked.rate: locked if rateOf amount, else exact

band.ownerQuestion: dashboard.html shows ranges such as 5–9; this cell shape has only <N

quarter.when: the route asks grain=quarter (the 'small school' state), or the preset has fewer than 10 active payers over the rolling 12 months
quarter.amountsAndEventCounts: sum of the quarter's months up to the clock month
quarter.distinctCountsCell: not_computed: distinct holders per quarter are not in the mart
quarter.rates: recomputed from the quarter's summed inputs; arpa is not_computed (needs distinct paying members)
quarter.rule: a quarter cell passes the cell rule only if every month in it passes (conservative)
quarter.openPeriod: the quarter that contains the clock month is the open period and is listed in partialPeriods

labels.suppressed: Hidden: fewer than 5 families or one family over 60%
labels.blocked: Blocked: atm does not post renewal resets yet, so this balance goes negative

formats.money: Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', { style: 'currency', currency: document.currency }) from integer minor units: 62300 USD -> $623.00, 62300 EUR -> €623.00
